sourceMatches.sql: SELECT "botId" FROM coordinator_bots WHERE "ownerId"=$1 AND "workspaceId"=$2
BEGIN
BEGIN
SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended($1,0))
SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended($1,0))
SELECT pg_try_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended($1,0)) AS acquired
SELECT pg_try_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended($1,0)) AS acquired
SELECT 1 FROM coordinator_bots WHERE "ownerId"=$1 AND "workspaceId"=$2 AND "botId"=$3
SELECT id FROM factory_tasks WHERE "userId"=$1 AND "botId" IS NULL ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE NOWAIT
SELECT id FROM coordinator_events WHERE "userId"=$1 AND "botId" IS NULL ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE NOWAIT
SELECT id FROM agent_runs WHERE "userId"=$1 AND "botId" IS NULL ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE NOWAIT
SELECT 1 FROM coordinator_sessions WHERE "userId"=$1 AND ("botId" IS NULL OR "botId"=$2) FOR UPDATE NOWAIT
SELECT coalesce(max(position),0)::int AS last FROM coordinator_messages WHERE "userId"=$1 AND "botId"=$2

UPDATE coordinator_messages m SET "botId"=$2, position=$3 + n.rank
    FROM (SELECT id, CASE WHEN $3=0 THEN position ELSE row_number() OVER (ORDER BY position) END AS rank
      FROM coordinator_messages WHERE "userId"=$1 AND "botId" IS NULL) n
    WHERE m.id=n.id
SELECT * FROM coordinator_sessions WHERE "userId"=$1 AND "botId" IS NULL

UPDATE user_schedules s SET bot_id=$2, workspace_id=$3 WHERE s.owner_id=$1 AND s.bot_id IS NULL
      AND (s.workspace_id=$3 OR (s.workspace_id IS NULL AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM coordinator_events e WHERE e.id=s.source_event_id AND e."userId"=$1 AND e."botId"=$2)))
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_schedules o WHERE o.owner_id=$1 AND o.bot_id=$2 AND o.request_id=s.request_id)
UPDATE suggestions SET "botId"=$2 WHERE "userId"=$1 AND "botId" IS NULL
UPDATE pending_actions SET "botId"=$2 WHERE "userId"=$1 AND "botId" IS NULL
COMMIT
COMMIT
